name: strava-run-coach
description: Marketplace for the strava-run-coach plugin: an AI-native, stdlib-only running coach with Strava MCP ingestion, VDOT forecasts, fitness tracking, and plan generation.

plugins.name: strava-run-coach
plugins.description: AI-native running coach over the Strava MCP: zero-question setup from your Strava profile and zones, graded run reviews, plans built around your race and your week, weekly check-ins, Daniels VDOT forecasts, CTL/ATL/TSB fitness. Zero dependencies - the whole engine is Python stdlib.
